GEAR FROM THE VIDEOS

The kit from the videos.

Every item named in our long videos, with why it is in the kit.

Every Fishing Lure Explained

  • 6'6"–7'0" Medium Fast Spinning Rod & 2500 Reel — One balanced all-around setup that casts light 1/8 oz grubs cleanly while keeping enough backbone to drive single worm hooks home.
  • 15 lb Braided Main Line + 10 lb Fluorocarbon Leader — Low-stretch braid gives long casts and crisp hooksets, while a clear fluorocarbon leader resists rock abrasion and stays stealthy.
  • Cupped Topwater Popper (2.5–3 in, Bone or Shad) — Starter lure #1: spits surface spray and sits still beside shallow cover so dawn and dusk predators can track it easily.
  • 3/8 oz Tandem Spinnerbait (White / Chartreuse) — Starter lure #2: V-arm wire frame deflects cleanly through brush and grass while flashing blades call fish out of wind or stain.
  • Medium-Diving Crankbait (4–8 ft, Shad or Perch) — Starter lure #3: digs down quickly and ricochets off submerged rocks and timber to trigger fast reaction strikes.
  • 3 in Curly-Tail Grubs + 1/8 oz Round Jigheads — Starter lure #4: counts down to any depth in open water and catches bass, walleye, trout, crappie, and perch on a simple slow retrieve.
  • 6–7 in Soft Plastic Worms + 3/0 EWG Hooks & 3/16 oz Bullet Weights — Starter lure #5: hides the hook point inside the plastic so you can crawl sunken wood, weeds, and bottom structure without snagging.
  • Stainless Duolock Snaps, Barrel Swivels & Pike Wire Traces — Snaps let you swap hard plugs in seconds, barrel swivels stop inline spinners from twisting line, and wire traces block pike teeth.
  • 6.5 in Long-Nose Fishing Pliers with Braid Cutters — Keeps fingers clear when unhooking treble plugs and snips braided or fluorocarbon tag ends cleanly.
  • Polarized Amber Sunglasses & Soft Rubber-Mesh Landing Net — Polarized lenses cut surface glare to spot shallow structure and following fish; rubber mesh protects fish slime and never tangles trebles.

Every Fishing Knot Explained

  • Stainless Fishing Line Nippers (Mono, Fluoro & Braid) — Flush-ground stainless jaws trim monofilament, fluorocarbon, and braided tag ends cleanly to a neat 1/8-inch tag without fraying the knot.
  • Quick Fishing Knot-Tying Tool (Tie-Fast / Hook-Safe) — Holds tiny hooks safely and guides smooth nail, clinch, and snell wraps cleanly when fingers are cold, wet, or tying light leader.
